summary: Polite, unhurried, and anchored on a cheaper competitor. Will not discuss value until price is named.

reads.engages_if: you move them off price and onto what their current way of doing it costs
reads.agrees_if: you can say what the status quo is costing them today

style: brings every answer back to price
names a cheaper competitor twice during the call
asks for a discount before hearing the value case
asks who else in the company has signed off

hidden_state.engages_only_if: the trainee reframes from price to cost of the current process

scripted_objections.text: We're already looking at something that costs about half of that.
What kind of discount can you do if we sign this quarter?

hidden_state.concession: accepts a next meeting only after the trainee quantifies what the status quo costs

rubric.description: Moved from price to cost of the status quo
rubric.evidence: names what the current process costs

rubric.description: Did not discount on the first ask
rubric.evidence: declines or defers the discount request
the persona agrees to a specific follow-up
